title: Company OKR Roadmap: Q2 cross-functional alignment and initiative cadence
creator: Sofia Gonzalez
description: Coordinate a single, company-level OKR and roadmap alignment process for Q2 to ensure all cross-functional initiatives (Runtime, Dedicated, Private, Console, Optimize) are prioritized against company objectives. Deliverables: a consolidated Q2 initiative map, a clear cadence for weekly syncs and decision milestones, rollup of engineering capacity constraints, and a leadership review packet for March 31. Scope includes defining OKR owners, success metrics, risk flags, rollout gates, and escalation paths. This ticket is the program-level coordination task that will spawn tactical tickets per team and feed the executive OKR review.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Consolidated initiative map published to Confluence and shared with engineering/design/ops; 2) Weekly cadence established with calendar invites and owner list; 3) All top-20 cross-functional initiatives have owners, clear metrics, and identified dependencies; 4) Leadership review packet approved by VP Product and VP Eng by 2026-03-31; 5) Roadmap changes gated and communicated to teams with migration/rollback plans where applicable.
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with ENG, Design, and PM. Agreed on high-level success metrics (latency SLOs, cost/unit targets, adoption milestones). Action items assigned: ENG to publish capacity constraints (ENG-5011), Design to produce impact mockups for Console changes (DES-204).

2026-03-05: Draft initiative map created and uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/OKR-2026-Q2-Initiatives. Early observation: three runtime perf projects compete for the same GPU commits—need prioritization by 2026-03-12.

2026-03-08: Cross-functional workshop. Decided to group initiatives into three tiers (Company-critical, Growth, Platform-maintenance). Marcus to prepare leadership tradeoff memo. ENG provided updated throughput forecasts in ENG-5120.
2026-03-11: Leadership pre-brief. VP Product suggested moving two Console UX items to Q3 unless telemetry shows regression risk. Action: PMs to produce a short risk analysis by 2026-03-16.

2026-03-13: Risk analysis submitted (link to Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cOKR-Q2. Found a regression risk in KV cache changes; mitigation options listed with estimates. Scheduled deep-dive with runtime team on 2026-03-16.
2026-03-14: Leadership packet v0 completed and shared for review. Next: incorporate feedback from Security and Customer Success before final approval.
2026-03-14: Added dependencies: ENG-5011 (capacity), DES-204 (console mockups). Noted potential scheduling conflict with Dedicated capacity rollout window (runtime-1.18).
comments: Marcus Liu (2026-03-03): Please clarify which latency SLO changes are candidate vs required for Q2. Action: Sofia to list must-have vs nice-to-have by 2026-03-06.
Aisha Patel, Eng (2026-03-07): We can delay the non-critical kernel optimization to Q3 if it helps free GPU allocation for the higher-impact batching work.
Design review (2026-03-12): DES-204 mockups look good; need copy alignment with marketing for launch materials. Design follow-up ticket created.
VP Product (2026-03-14): Approve v0 packet to go to security and CS for final read — ensure we have rollback criteria for any initiative touching customer-facing latency.
notes: Decision log: Grouped initiatives into tier 1/2/3 for resource allocation; tier 1 gets first pass for Dedicated GPU commits.
Meeting cadence: Weekly sync Tuesdays 10:00-10:45 AM PT; Leadership review every other Wednesday 3:00 PM PT during March.
Files: Confluence initiative map, Drive risk analysis, Deck for leadership packet (company-2026-q2-roadmap-deck-v0.pptx).
